en: Dependent on a cause, and also on a state that has a cause, there arises a state that is not a cause, and which is both not a cause and not without a cause, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on a state that is not a cause, but which has a cause and is not itself a root, there arises a state that is not a non-cause, and which is both not a non-cause and not without a root, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on a root-cause and a state associated with a root-cause, there arises a non-root-cause state that is both a non-root-cause and dissociated from a root-cause, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a non-root-cause state that is associated with a root-cause but is not itself a root-cause, there arises a non-non-root-cause state that is both dissociated from a non-root-cause and is not itself a non-root-cause, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition: one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a non-root, non-root, root-possessing state, there arises a non-root, non-root, non-root-possessing state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] and predominance [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], one.

Dependent on a non-root, non-root, rootless state, there arises a non-root, non-root, non-rootless state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], one.
